001: Shota, have you decided on your dorm room yet?
Yeah, I got a corner room on the third floor.
You can see the park from the window, and it feels pretty good.
That's great to hear. Can I come visit sometime?
002: How's the food at the dorm cafeteria?
Hmm, well, it's just okay, I guess.
Yeah, I figured as much. Is the portion size big?
The portions are big, but the flavor is a bit strong.
I see. Sounds like it'll be tough until you get used to it.
But it's cheap, so it really helps me out.
003: What time is the dorm curfew?
Eleven at night. It's a bit early, you know.
That's rough. Can you make it back in time after your part-time job?
I manage to make it, but it's tough when I'm in a hurry.
Having a curfew makes you think twice about evening plans.
Exactly. But it's the rule, so there's no helping it.
004: Have you gotten close with the person next door?
Yeah, they're in the same department, so we talk a lot.
That's reassuring. Do you study together and stuff?
We sometimes help each other out.
That sounds like a good relationship. My neighbor is so quiet it's a bit lonely.
Well, on the bright side, it probably means you can focus well.
005: Is there a washing machine in the dorm?
Yeah, there is. But it's only on the first floor, so going down every time is a hassle.
That does sound tough. Does it get crowded?
It's pretty crowded at night, so I try to go early in the morning.
You've found a way to manage. Is there a dryer too?
Yeah, there is. It's a lifesaver on rainy days.
006: It's about six tatami mats, which is just about right for one person.
Nice. Having your own space is important, right?
Yeah. But I have a lot of stuff, so I'm struggling with storage.
Why don't you use the space under your bed?
Oh, that's a good idea. I'll give it a try.
007: Do you eat breakfast at the dorm?
Yeah, I eat at the cafeteria. It's usually bread, eggs, and salad.
That's healthy. As for me, I often forget to eat.
That's not good. You need to eat properly.
You're right. I'll try hard to get up from tomorrow.
Want to eat together? I'll call out to you.
008: Is there a supermarket near the dorm?
Yeah, there is. It's about a five-minute walk away.
That's convenient. Is it open late at night?
It's open until eleven. It's reassuring for when you suddenly need something.
Nice. Will you come shopping with me sometime?
Of course. Just let me know anytime.
009: Do you have events at the dorm or anything?
Yeah, there's a party every season. Last month we had a cherry blossom viewing.
That sounds nice. Getting together with everyone seems fun.
It is. There are people from all kinds of countries, and it's interesting to talk with them.
So you get to do international exchange too. Sounds like a great experience.
Yeah, it might be the best part of dorm life.
010: Is there anything you're struggling with at the dorm?
Let me think... Sometimes the hallway gets noisy at night.
That's annoying. Did you tell the landlord?
I haven't said anything yet. I feel awkward bringing it up directly.
Why don't you talk to the management office? I'm sure they'll do something about it.
Yeah, you're right. I'll go ask them next time. Thanks.
